comment.narrative: Final target date updated with estimated Project completion date as per Amendment No 1 to the Delegation Agreement.

This activity was undertaken by the Traffic Management Specialist in September 2019 and modelling forsignal phasing at 4intersections on Kaysone Phomvihane road was prepared as well as trafficmanagement plan in Vientiane Capital Center was drafted. The traffic management plan was beingdeveloped and partially submitted. The PIC also arranged the workshop on a new traffic managementGeneral of DPWT Vientiane Capital and the second workshop on the traffic management plan wasscheduled to arrange in March 2020. Unfortunately it cannot be arranged caused by the COVID19pandemic and no international traffic management specialist was available to join the workshop.However the said workshop was arranged on 6 November 2020 in the DPWT meeting room fordiscussing the traffic management plan in Vientiane core area and along the BRT corridor between theconcerned government stakeholders DPWT PCU and the PIC chaired by the Director General ofDPWT. The draft traffic management plan was revised and submitted on 29 March 2021 to the PCU forreview and approval. The revised traffic management plan was presented to the concerned governmentstakeholders DOT DHUP and DPWT for seeking some commentsadvices.

comment.narrative: Final target date updated with estimated Project completion date as per Amendment No 1 to the Delegation Agreement.

Draft detailed parking management plan was presented to MPWTDOT and VCOMS and its draft planVersion 2 was submitted on 28 August 2019 to the PCU for review and comment. The PIC team haddiscussed the onstreet paid parking management plan in Vientiane City Center with the Office of PublicWorks and Transport OPWT Chanthabouly District management and some recommendations wereprovided by the OPWT. The draft specifications contract and tender documents for parking managementcompany Version 01 was prepared and submitted on 11 December 2019 to the PCU for review andcomments. The draft specifications tender documents and contract for parking management companyVersion 02 was submitted on 26 February 2020 to the PCU for review and comments and the draftspecifications tender documents and contract for parking management company Version 03 wassubmitted on 12 April 2021 to the PCU for review and waiting for approval.Draft EVR system was prepared but not submitted yet while EVR is being taken into consideration ofMPWT with requesting the financing support from JICA for continuing its development because EVR wasbeing implemented by the government since 2014 prior to project approval. The workshop on EVR wasarranged on 21 June 2019 in MPWTDOT by JICA. As discussed during the Lenders MTR mission thePP2 EVR package will be removed from the project component.
